explication: Capso is a native macOS screenshot and screen-recording app. Users start capture or recording from its menu-bar/HUD workflows, then annotate, inspect, export, copy, pin, or retain results in history. Separate capabilities handle OCR/translation and optional cloud sharing. The graph combines README-documented workflows with source-index relationships; several app-level subsystems are represented from documented capabilities because their implementation excerpts were not provided.
